data.summary: Reviews appear authentic but present a mixed and concerning picture. Positive reviews are detailed and cite long-term satisfaction, particularly for maintenance and remodeling. However, the negative reviews are severe, alleging neglect, property damage, and ghosting. The low total review count for a decades-old business is a red flag, and the polarized rating distribution suggests inconsistent service quality or potential issues with customer retention and resolution.
fake_signals: Low review volume (14 total) for a 23-year-old business is unusual
Google reviews show a polarized distribution (mostly 5-star and 1-star, no middle ground)

negative_evidence: Refused to take accountability for damage caused during service (stained concrete)

authentic_signals: Specific, detailed project descriptions in positive reviews (e.g., 'remodeled pool with new tile, coping, plaster')
Long-term customer relationships mentioned (22 years, 10 years)
Negative reviews contain specific allegations with details (equipment failure, staining concrete, ghosting)
complaint_patterns: Damage to property and refusal to take accountability
data.discrepancy_explanation: Limited review data across platforms. Google rating is moderate, BBB rating is high but based on business profile, not customer reviews. No significant discrepancy can be assessed due to lack of comparable review data.

reviews.text:
Finally... an honest review!
This particular pool company has the worst cleaning service!  I paid a premium weekly fee, but received very poor service for over 6 months!  I sent numerous emails, texts, and left several phone messages of concern.  All were unanswered until I sent a notice to discontinue service!
Took water sample to local pool store.  Was explained that pool had constant algae growth due to lack of applied chemicals.   However, Weber pool said it was from leafs falling into the pool.  That statement proved that either; they don't know what they are doing, or they just collect a premium fee, and provide minimal service!  They prey on homeowners that have no experience or knowledge of cleaning their own pool, or working their own pool equipment.  Take the time to know how you pool system works, to avoid a potential service ripoff!
I would NOT recommend Weber Pools!
reviews.author: Giant Texan

reviews.text: Weber Pools has maintained my pool for 22 years, with efficient and reliable service so that it is always clean and everything is in top working order.  Any issues they come immediately – I love that.  Weber also remodeled my pool with new tile, coping, plaster, jets and modern lighting. Especially valuable to me was their design creativity that resulted in a striking yet elegant and tasteful upgrade.  Weber also remodeled the pool decking and wood porch, for a one-stop integrated look that made the entire process easy and worthy of a magazine shoot.
reviews.author: David McCombs

reviews.text: Kevin at Weber has always been fantastic to work with. I used his company in the past when I managed HOAs and recently used him on our personal pool. He’s very professional, timely and performs great work. Highly recommend him to anyone!
reviews.author: Claudia Glaubitz

reviews.text: Five Star Plus.  We are a commercial HOA pool and Weber Pools has recovered it from a disastrous condition of the previous pool company. We had a severe black algae problem and we were always dealing with poor water quality. Now we get compliments on the cleanliness and water quality from all our homeowners that use the pool. Remington Park HOA.
reviews.author: ATR 717

reviews.text: By far the best pool service around. We’ve tried numerous company’s from large to small. Weber shows up every week when scheduled and provides the best service and most importantly the best customer service! They are always willing to help me understand what they are doing and why they are doing it. Their prices are the best around which makes it even better. If your looking for a reputable, educated , and affordable pool service Weber is that company!
reviews.author: Ray Mahar

reviews.text: I am a Weber customer now for about 10 years. Their service and customer satisfaction goals are always top notch. I am always comfortable with any decision or recommendation regarding my pool service. I switched to Kevin's business because of issues with another service and I am so  pleased that I did....no regrets!
reviews.author: Linda Williams

reviews.text: Keeps our pool crystal clear all year long. Great reliable service , always very friendly and always very professional.
reviews.author: Karla Patella

reviews.text: My pool company subcontracted Kevin at Weber pools to do a reverse osmosis on my pool. He had some equipment failure that caused my pool to drain several feet of water and his hose leaked something on my concrete around the pool and it has permanently stained it. When this was brought to his attention by my pool company, he ghosted them. He took no accountability for the stain, the water that had to be replaced, or the incomplete job.
reviews.author: Rob Lapporte
